rationale: The official Penguin Random House page lists the 2018 hardcover and the 2019 paperback under the same work page and shows both at 624 pages.
The Google Books authorized preview exposes the same work family and shows a contents page with a substantive Introduction followed by the law sequence.
Bibliographic records from Open Library and IUCAT corroborate the English work family and the chapter sequence.
No frozen source showed a competing English edition with a different chapter count, order, or materially different meaning.
